mission.p: We aim to provide technological solutions, achieve the highest standards, and deliver the best services in line with quality management for customer satisfaction in machining.

vision.p: To become one of Turkey's leading company, while providing efficiently, competitively, technologically, and environmentally friendly products and services to our valued customers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our services and processes.

items.question: Is there a minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Since we work on a project basis, there is no minimum order quantity. Prototype and low-volume production are also accepted.

items.question: What tolerances can you achieve?
items.answer: Depending on the part and material, CNC machining can be performed with tolerances down to ±0.01 mm. Final tolerances are evaluated based on technical drawings.

items.question: Do you offer serial production?
items.answer: Yes. In addition to one-off projects, we also have the infrastructure and machine capacity for serial production.

items.question: Which industries do you serve?
items.answer: We provide CNC machining solutions for automotive, machinery manufacturing, defense industry, and industrial production sectors.

items.question: How can I request a quotation?
items.answer: You can receive a fast quotation by contacting us with technical drawings and production details.
